description:
Surfaced by bedrock-q67.25. Now that \xff/system/config/desired_commit_proxies is authoritative, editing the coordinator's value has no effect on a cluster past its first recovery - and there is no supported way to change the parameter at all.

A client commit touching \xff/... is rejected at ingress; only the director and the distributor commit mode: :system, and neither exposes a config-change API. FDB's equivalent is an ordinary transaction: changeConfig (fdbclient/include/fdbclient/GenericManagementAPI.actor.h:256) creates a transaction, sets the \xff/conf/ keys and commits - clients reach system keys through the ACCESS_SYSTEM_KEYS option, which Bedrock's mode: :system is the analogue of.

Needed: an operator-facing way to commit a \xff/system/config/ mutation (the analogue of ACCESS_SYSTEM_KEYS, or a narrow admin API on the coordinator/director that submits the system-mode transaction), so the keyspace copy is genuinely changeable and not merely authoritative-and-frozen. Until this lands, a committed parameter is fixed at seed time.

Before this, changing desired_commit_proxies meant editing the object-storage cluster bootstrap and waiting for the next recovery.
title: No operator path to change a committed cluster config parameter
